findings.title: Missing key prop on GrafanaRuleListItem in list
findings.body: When `GrafanaRuleLoader` was replaced with `GrafanaRuleListItem`, the `key={key}` prop was dropped. This element is rendered inside `rules.map(...)`. Without a key, React warns and reconciles items by index. Since the list grows incrementally as pages load, items can be mismatched and lose state such as an open menu or modal.

findings.title: Pause and Delete never shown in list view despite prom-based abilities
findings.body: `canPause` and `canDelete` now include the prom-rule abilities, but the menu items still require a `rulerRule`. Pause is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` and Delete on `canDelete && rulerRule`. The list view no longer passes a ruler rule, so users with permission silently lose the Pause and Delete actions there. The new test asserts exactly 4 items, which locks in this regression.

findings.title: Silence menu item does nothing without ruler rule
findings.body: The silence drawer is rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. In the list view `rule` is undefined, yet `canSilence` can be true via the prom abilities, so the 'Silence notifications' item is shown. Clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer` to true but nothing renders, so the action is a no-op for the user.

findings.title: Export ability excludes Grafana recording rules
findings.body: For prom rules, ModifyExport is supported only when `isAlertingRule` is true. The ruler-based version uses `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule`, which also covers recording rules. As a result, Grafana recording rules lose the Export option in the list view.
